99 {
100 mp_limb_t b0 = bp[0], b1 = bp[1];
101 mp_limb_t alo = 0, ahi = 0;
102 mp_size_t i = 0;
103
104 /* 双 limb 滚动累加器 alo*B^i + ahi*B^(i+1)：t 收纳本位（含 numa[i] 与 b0 行），
105 u 收纳上位（b1 行 + t 进位），两项各 < B^2 无 u128 回绕 */
106 for (; i < n; i++) {
107 __uint128_t t = (__uint128_t)numb[i] * b0 + numa[i] + alo;
108 __uint128_t u = (__uint128_t)numb[i] * b1 + ahi + (mp_limb_t)(t >> 64);
109 numa[i] = (mp_limb_t)t;
110 alo = (mp_limb_t)u;
111 ahi = (mp_limb_t)(u >> 64);
112 }
113 numa[n] = alo;
114 return ahi;
115}

26 {
27 lmmp_param_assert(n > 0);
28 lmmp_param_assert(numa != NULL);
29 lmmp_param_assert(numb != NULL);
30 /* 顶部剥皮 r = 4,1,2,3 个 limb（依 n mod 4，0 取 4）：短行程早退窗口，
31 余段长度恰为 4 的倍数，下方 4-limb 步进无需标量尾与运行时版本化 */
32 mp_size_t r = n & 3;
33 if (r == 0) r = 4;
34 for (mp_size_t k = 0; k < r; k++) {
35 mp_limb_t x = numa[n - 1 - k];
36 mp_limb_t y = numb[n - 1 - k];
37 if (x != y)
38 return (x > y ? 1 : -1);
39 }
40 /* 余段自顶向下按 4 limb 一组：异或折叠判差，有差组内自顶定位 */
41 for (mp_size_t i = n - r; i != 0;) {
42 i -= 4;
43 mp_limb_t d = (numa[i + 0] ^ numb[i + 0]) | (numa[i + 1] ^ numb[i + 1]) |
44 (numa[i + 2] ^ numb[i + 2]) | (numa[i + 3] ^ numb[i + 3]);
45 if (d) {
46 for (mp_size_t j = i + 3; j >= i; j--) {
47 if (numa[j] != numb[j])
48 return (numa[j] > numb[j] ? 1 : -1);
49 }
50 }
51 }
52 return 0;
53}

85 {
86 lmmp_param_assert(na >= nb);
87 lmmp_param_assert(numa != NULL && numb != NULL && nb > 0);
88 lmmp_param_assert(numb[nb - 1] > 0);
89 if (nb == 1) {
90 mp_limb_t rem = lmmp_div_1_(dstq, numa, na, *numb);
91 if (dstr)
92 *dstr = rem;
93 } else if (nb == 2) {
94 mp_limb_t brem[2];
95 brem[0] = numb[0];
96 brem[1] = numb[1];
97 lmmp_div_2_(dstq, numa, na, brem);
98 if (dstr) {
99 dstr[0] = brem[0];
100 dstr[1] = brem[1];
101 }
102 } else {
103 int adjust = numa[na - 1] >= numb[nb - 1];
104 int cnt = lmmp_leading_zeros_(numb[nb - 1]);
105 mp_size_t nq = na + adjust - nb;
106 if (nq == 0) {
107 if (dstr && dstr != numa)
108 lmmp_copy(dstr, numa, nb);
109 if (dstq)
110 dstq[0] = 0;
111 return;
112 }
113 TEMP_DECL;
114
115 if (!dstq)
116 dstq = TALLOC_TYPE(na - nb + 1, mp_limb_t);
117 dstq[na - nb] = 0;

121 mp_ptr numb2;
122 if (cnt) {
123 numa2[na] = lmmp_shl_(numa2, numa, na, cnt);
124 numb2 = TALLOC_TYPE(nb, mp_limb_t);
125 lmmp_shl_(numb2, numb, nb, cnt);
126 } else {
127 numa2[na] = 0;
128 lmmp_copy(numa2, numa, na);
129 numb2 = (mp_ptr)numb;
130 }

132 mp_limb_t inv21 = lmmp_inv_2_1_(numb2[nb - 1], numb2[nb - 2]);
133 na += adjust;
134
135 if (nb < DIV_DIVIDE_THRESHOLD)
136 lmmp_div_basecase_(dstq, numa2, na, numb2, nb, inv21);
137 else if (nb < DIV_MULINV_L_THRESHOLD || na < 2 * DIV_MULINV_N_THRESHOLD)
138 lmmp_div_divide_(dstq, numa2, na, numb2, nb, inv21);
139 else {
140 mp_limb_t ni = lmmp_div_inv_size_(nq, nb);
141 mp_ptr invappr = TALLOC_TYPE(ni, mp_limb_t);
142 lmmp_inv_prediv_(invappr, numb2, nb, ni);
143 lmmp_div_mulinv_(dstq, numa2, na, numb2, nb, invappr, ni);
144 }
145
146 if (dstr) {
147 lmmp_shr_(dstr, numa2, nb, cnt); // cnt=0 时函数内即整段拷贝
148 }
149 } else {
150 // nq=na-nb+adj<nb
151 //-> na+adj>=2nq+1
152 mp_size_t ni = nb - nq;
153 mp_ptr numa2, numb2;
154 mp_ptr tp = TALLOC_TYPE(nb, mp_limb_t);
155 mp_limb_t cy;
156
157 numa2 = TALLOC_TYPE(nq * 2 + 1, mp_limb_t);
158 if (cnt) {
159 numb2 = TALLOC_TYPE(nq, mp_limb_t);
160 lmmp_shl_(numb2, numb + ni, nq, cnt);
161 numb2[0] |= numb[ni - 1] >> (LIMB_BITS - cnt);
162 cy = lmmp_shl_(numa2, numa + na - 2 * nq, 2 * nq, cnt);
163 if (adjust) {
164 numa2[2 * nq] = cy;
165 ++numa2; // numa2[0] is as significant as numa[ni=na-2nq+adjust]
166 } else
167 numa2[0] |= numa[na - 2 * nq - 1] >> (LIMB_BITS - cnt);
168 } else {
169 numb2 = (mp_ptr)numb + ni;
170 lmmp_copy(numa2, numa + na - 2 * nq, 2 * nq);
171 if (adjust) {
172 numa2[2 * nq] = 0;
173 ++numa2;
174 }
175 }
176
177 // now: 0<=numa2<B^2nq, B^nq/2<=numb2<B^nq, and 0<=numa2/numb2<B^nq
178 // ignored bits could be seen as fraction part of numa and numb
179 // we can prove: Q<=Qh<=Q+2
180 // where Q=floor(numa/numb) is the real quotient
181 // Qh=floor(floor(numa)/floor(numb)) as below
182
183 if (nq == 1) {
184 lmmp_div_1_s_(dstq, numa2, 2, *numb2);
185 } else if (nq == 2) {
186 lmmp_div_2_s_(dstq, numa2, 4, numb2);
187 } else {
188 mp_limb_t inv21 = lmmp_inv_2_1_(numb2[nq - 1], numb2[nq - 2]);
189
190 if (nq < DIV_DIVIDE_THRESHOLD)
191 lmmp_div_basecase_(dstq, numa2, 2 * nq, numb2, nq, inv21);
192 else if (nq < DIV_MULINV_N_THRESHOLD)

194 else {
195 mp_size_t inv_ni = lmmp_div_inv_size_(nq, nq);
196 mp_ptr invappr = tp;
197 lmmp_inv_prediv_(invappr, numb2, nq, inv_ni);
198 lmmp_div_mulinv_(dstq, numa2, 2 * nq, numb2, nq, invappr, inv_ni);
199 }
200 }
201 /*
202 true remainder = partial remainder - quotient * ignored divisor limbs
203
204 Multiply the first ignored divisor limb by the most significant
205 quotient limb. If that product is > the partial remainder's
206 most significant limb, we know the quotient is too large. This
207 test quickly catches most cases where the quotient is too large;
208 it catches all cases where the quotient is 2 too large.*/
209
210 mp_limb_t x;
211 if (cnt) {
212 mp_limb_t dl;
213 if (ni < 2)
214 dl = 0;
215 else
216 dl = numb[ni - 2];
217 x = (numb[ni - 1] << cnt) | (dl >> (LIMB_BITS - cnt));
218 } else
219 x = numb[ni - 1];
220 mp_limb_t h = (x >> LIMB_BITS / 2) * (dstq[nq - 1] >> LIMB_BITS / 2);
221 mp_limb_t rnb = 0; // remainder[nb]
222 mp_size_t nr = nq; // remainder=rnb:[numa2,nr]:[...,ni]
223
224 if (h > numa2[nq - 1]) {
225 lmmp_dec(dstq);
226 rnb = lmmp_add_n_(numa2, numa2, numb2, nq);
227 }
228
229 // if cnt, recover the shift of partial remainder
230 // and remove the effect of the partial-ignored numa[ni-1] and numb[ni-1]
231 if (cnt) {
232 numa2[nq] = rnb;
233 ++nr;
234 --ni;
235 lmmp_shl_(numa2, numa2, nr, LIMB_BITS - cnt);
236 numa2[0] |= numa[ni] & (LIMB_MAX >> cnt);
237 cy = lmmp_submul_1_(numa2, dstq, nq, numb[ni] & (LIMB_MAX >> cnt));
238 rnb = -(numa2[nq] < cy);
239 numa2[nq] -= cy;
240 }
241
242 if (ni == 0) {
243 if (dstr) {
244 if (rnb)
245 lmmp_add_n_(dstr, numa2, numb, nr);
246 else
247 lmmp_copy(dstr, numa2, nr);
248 }
249 } else {
250 tp[nb - 1] = 0;
251 if (ni < nq)
252 lmmp_mul_(tp, dstq, nq, numb, ni);
253 else
254 lmmp_mul_(tp, numb, ni, dstq, nq);
255
256 if (dstr) {
257 mp_ptr remptr = dstr == numb ? tp : dstr;
258 cy = lmmp_sub_n_(remptr, numa, tp, ni);
259 rnb -= lmmp_sub_nc_(remptr + ni, numa2, tp + ni, nr, cy);
260 if (rnb)
261 lmmp_add_n_(dstr, remptr, numb, nb);
262 else if (dstr != remptr)
263 lmmp_copy(dstr, remptr, nb);
264 } else {
265 int hcmp = lmmp_cmp_(numa2, tp + ni, nr);
266 if (hcmp < 0)
267 --rnb;
268 else if (hcmp == 0)
269 rnb -= (lmmp_cmp_(numa, tp, ni) < 0);
270 }
271 }
272
273 if (rnb)
274 lmmp_dec(dstq);
275 }
276
277 TEMP_FREE;
278 }
279}

27 {
28 mp_limb_t r, m;
29 {
30 mp_limb_t p, ql;
31 unsigned ul, uh, qh;
32
33 /* For notation, let b denote the half-limb base, so that B = b^2.
34 Split u1 = b uh + ul. */
35 ul = xh & LLIMB_MASK;
36 uh = xh >> (LIMB_BITS / 2);
37
38 /* Approximation of the high half of quotient. Differs from the 2/1
39 inverse of the half limb uh, since we have already subtracted
40 u0. */
41 qh = (xh ^ LIMB_MAX) / uh;
42
43 /* Adjust to get a half-limb 3/2 inverse, i.e., we want
44
45 qh' = floor( (b^3 - 1) / u) - b = floor ((b^3 - b u - 1) / u
46 = floor( (b (~u) + b-1) / u),
47
48 and the remainder
49
50 r = b (~u) + b-1 - qh (b uh + ul)
51 = b (~u - qh uh) + b-1 - qh ul
52
53 Subtraction of qh ul may underflow, which implies adjustments.
54 But by normalization, 2 u >= B > qh ul, so we need to adjust by
55 at most 2.
56 */
57
58 r = ((~xh - (mp_limb_t)qh * uh) << (LIMB_BITS / 2)) | LLIMB_MASK;
59
60 p = (mp_limb_t)qh * ul;
61 /* Adjustment steps taken from udiv_qrnnd_c */
62 if (r < p) {
63 qh--;
64 r += xh;
65 if (r >= xh) /* i.e. we didn't get carry when adding to r */
66 if (r < p) {
67 qh--;
68 r += xh;
69 }
70 }
71 r -= p;
72
73 /* Low half of the quotient is
74
75 ql = floor ( (b r + b-1) / u1).
76
77 This is a 3/2 division (on half-limbs), for which qh is a
78 suitable inverse. */
79
80 p = (r >> (LIMB_BITS / 2)) * qh + r;
81 /* Unlike full-limb 3/2, we can add 1 without overflow. For this to
82 work, it is essential that ql is a full mp_limb_t. */
83 ql = (p >> (LIMB_BITS / 2)) + 1;
84
85 /* By the 3/2 trick, we don't need the high half limb. */
86 r = (r << (LIMB_BITS / 2)) + LLIMB_MASK - ql * xh;
87
88 if (r >= (LIMB_MAX & (p << (LIMB_BITS / 2)))) {
89 ql--;
90 r += xh;
91 }
92 m = ((mp_limb_t)qh << (LIMB_BITS / 2)) + ql;
93 if (r >= xh) {
94 m++;
95 r -= xh;
96 }
97 }
98
99 /* Now m is the 2/1 inverse of u1. If u0 > 0, adjust it to become a
100 3/2 inverse. */
101 if (xl > 0) {
102 mp_limb_t th, tl;
103 r = ~r;
104 r += xl;
105 if (r < xl) {
106 m--;
107 if (r >= xh) {
108 m--;
109 r -= xh;
110 }
111 r -= xh;
112 }
113 _umul64to128_(xl, m, &tl, &th);
114 r += th;
115 if (r < th) {
116 m--;
117 m -= ((r > xh) | ((r == xh) & (tl > xl)));
118 }
119 }

121 return m;

27 {
28 /*
29 链式 (a_{k-1} >> 64) 进位提取使 GCC/Clang 均生成 add/adc 融合序列，
30 单 limb 链长约 2c，展开宽度 W 可将链摊薄为 (W+1)/W c：
31 - clang 会把 4 路链式源码回卷成 2 路（实测慢约 7~12%），6 路是其
32 能保持的最小宽度；
33 - gcc 恰好相反，4 路最优、6 路慢约 4%。
34 故按编译器选择展开宽度。
35 */
36 mp_limb_t cl = 0;
37 mp_size_t i = 0;
38
39#if defined(__clang__)
40 for (; i + 6 <= na; i += 6) {
41 __uint128_t a0 = (__uint128_t)numa[i + 0] * x + cl;
42 __uint128_t a1 = (__uint128_t)numa[i + 1] * x + (mp_limb_t)(a0 >> 64);
43 __uint128_t a2 = (__uint128_t)numa[i + 2] * x + (mp_limb_t)(a1 >> 64);
44 __uint128_t a3 = (__uint128_t)numa[i + 3] * x + (mp_limb_t)(a2 >> 64);
45 __uint128_t a4 = (__uint128_t)numa[i + 4] * x + (mp_limb_t)(a3 >> 64);
46 __uint128_t a5 = (__uint128_t)numa[i + 5] * x + (mp_limb_t)(a4 >> 64);
47 dst[i + 0] = (mp_limb_t)a0;
48 dst[i + 1] = (mp_limb_t)a1;
49 dst[i + 2] = (mp_limb_t)a2;
50 dst[i + 3] = (mp_limb_t)a3;
51 dst[i + 4] = (mp_limb_t)a4;
52 dst[i + 5] = (mp_limb_t)a5;
53 cl = (mp_limb_t)(a5 >> 64);
54 }
55#else
56 for (; i + 4 <= na; i += 4) {
57 __uint128_t a0 = (__uint128_t)numa[i + 0] * x + cl;
58 __uint128_t a1 = (__uint128_t)numa[i + 1] * x + (mp_limb_t)(a0 >> 64);
59 __uint128_t a2 = (__uint128_t)numa[i + 2] * x + (mp_limb_t)(a1 >> 64);
60 __uint128_t a3 = (__uint128_t)numa[i + 3] * x + (mp_limb_t)(a2 >> 64);
61 dst[i + 0] = (mp_limb_t)a0;
62 dst[i + 1] = (mp_limb_t)a1;
63 dst[i + 2] = (mp_limb_t)a2;
64 dst[i + 3] = (mp_limb_t)a3;
65 cl = (mp_limb_t)(a3 >> 64);
66 }
67#endif
68 for (; i < na; i++) {
69 __uint128_t a = (__uint128_t)numa[i] * x + cl;
70 dst[i] = (mp_limb_t)a;
71 cl = (mp_limb_t)(a >> 64);
72 }
73 return cl;
74}

112 {
113 const int nsqr = 1;
114 mp_size_t N = rn * LIMB_BITS; // 结果总比特数
115 mp_size_t k = lmmp_fft_best_k_(rn);
116 mp_size_t K = ((mp_size_t)1) << k; // FFT块数（2^k）
117 lmmp_debug_assert(!(N & (K - 1)));
118 mp_size_t M = N >> k; // 每个块的比特数
119 mp_size_t n = 2 * M + k + 2; // 扩展系数长度
120
121 n = (n + LIMB_BITS - 1) & (-LIMB_BITS);
122 n = (((n - 1) >> k) + 1) << k;
123
124 // 初始化内存栈
125 fft_memstack msr;
126 msr.maxdepth = -1;
127 msr.tempdepth = -1;
128 msr.lenw = n / LIMB_BITS;
129 mp_size_t nlen = msr.lenw + 1;
130
131 msr.temp_coef = (mp_ptr)lmmp_fft_memstack_(&msr, (((nlen + 1) << (k + nsqr)) + nlen) * LIMB_BYTES);
132
133 mp_ptr *pfca = (mp_ptr*)(msr.temp_coef + nlen), *pfcb = pfca;
134 mp_size_t narest = na * LIMB_BITS, nbrest = nb * LIMB_BITS;
135
136 for (mp_size_t i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
137 mp_size_t coeflen;
138 pfca[i] = (mp_ptr)(pfca + K) + i * nlen;
139 if (narest > 0) {
140 coeflen = M + (i == K - 1);
141 coeflen = LMMP_MIN(narest, coeflen);
142 narest -= coeflen;
143 lmmp_fft_extract_coef_(pfca[i], numa, M * i, coeflen, msr.lenw);
144 if (i > 0)
145 lmmp_fft_shl_coef_(&msr, pfca + i, i * n >> k);
146 } else {
147 lmmp_zero(pfca[i], nlen);
148 }
149 }
150 lmmp_fft_(&msr, pfca, k, n >> (k - 1));
151
152 pfcb += (nlen + 1) << k;
153 for (mp_size_t i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
154 mp_size_t coeflen;
155 pfcb[i] = (mp_ptr)(pfcb + K) + i * nlen;
156 if (nbrest > 0) {
157 coeflen = M + (i == K - 1);
158 coeflen = LMMP_MIN(nbrest, coeflen);
159 nbrest -= coeflen;
160 lmmp_fft_extract_coef_(pfcb[i], numb, M * i, coeflen, msr.lenw);
161 if (i > 0)
162 lmmp_fft_shl_coef_(&msr, pfcb + i, i * n >> k);
163 } else {
164 lmmp_zero(pfcb[i], nlen);
165 }
166 }
167 lmmp_fft_(&msr, pfcb, k, n >> (k - 1));
168
169 lmmp_mul_fermat_recurse_(&msr, pfca, pfcb, K);
170
171 lmmp_ifft_(&msr, pfca, k, n >> (k - 1));
172
173 lmmp_mul_fermat_recombine_(&msr, dst, pfca, K, k, n, M, rn);
174
175 // 处理模 B^rn+1 的溢出
176 if (dst[rn] && !lmmp_zero_q_(dst, rn)) {
177 dst[rn] = 0;
178 lmmp_dec(dst);
179 }
180
181 lmmp_fft_memstack_(&msr, 0);
182}

184 {
185 const int nsqr = 1;
186 mp_size_t N = rn * LIMB_BITS; // 结果总比特数
187 mp_size_t k = lmmp_fft_best_k_(rn); // 最优FFT层数
188 mp_size_t K = ((mp_size_t)1) << k; // FFT块数（2^k）
189 // 断言：N必须是K的整数倍
190 lmmp_debug_assert(!(N & (K - 1)));
191 mp_size_t M = N >> k; // 每个块的比特数
192 mp_size_t n = 2 * M + k; // 扩展系数长度（梅森数比费马数少2）
193
194 // 规整n：必须是LIMB_BITS和K/2的整数倍
195 n = (n + LIMB_BITS - 1) & (-LIMB_BITS);
196 n = (((n - 1) >> (k - 1)) + 1) << (k - 1);
197
198 // 初始化内存栈
199 fft_memstack msr;
200 msr.maxdepth = -1;
201 msr.tempdepth = -1;
202 msr.lenw = n / LIMB_BITS;
203 mp_size_t nlen = msr.lenw + 1;
204
205 msr.temp_coef = (mp_ptr)lmmp_fft_memstack_(&msr, (((nlen + 1) << (k + nsqr)) + nlen) * LIMB_BYTES);
206
207 mp_ptr *pfca = (mp_ptr*)(msr.temp_coef + nlen), *pfcb = pfca;
208 mp_size_t narest = na * LIMB_BITS, nbrest = nb * LIMB_BITS;
209
210 for (mp_size_t i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
211 mp_size_t coeflen;
212 pfca[i] = (mp_ptr)(pfca + K) + i * nlen;
213 if (narest > 0) {
214 coeflen = LMMP_MIN(narest, M);
215 narest -= coeflen;
216 lmmp_fft_extract_coef_(pfca[i], numa, M * i, coeflen, msr.lenw);
217 } else {
218 lmmp_zero(pfca[i], nlen);
219 }
220 }
221 lmmp_fft_(&msr, pfca, k, n >> (k - 1));
222
223 pfcb += (nlen + 1) << k;
224 for (mp_size_t i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
225 mp_size_t coeflen;
226 pfcb[i] = (mp_ptr)(pfcb + K) + i * nlen;
227 if (nbrest > 0) {
228 coeflen = LMMP_MIN(nbrest, M);
229 nbrest -= coeflen;
230 lmmp_fft_extract_coef_(pfcb[i], numb, M * i, coeflen, msr.lenw);
231 } else {
232 lmmp_zero(pfcb[i], nlen);
233 }
234 }
235 lmmp_fft_(&msr, pfcb, k, n >> (k - 1));
236
237 lmmp_mul_fermat_recurse_(&msr, pfca, pfcb, K);
238
239 lmmp_ifft_(&msr, pfca, k, n >> (k - 1));
240
241 mp_size_t rhead = 0, maxc = 0;
242 for (mp_size_t i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
243 lmmp_fft_shr_coef_(&msr, pfca + i, k);
244 mp_ptr nums = pfca[i];
245
246 if (nums[nlen - 1]) {
247 lmmp_dec(nums);
248 lmmp_debug_assert(nums[nlen - 1] == 1);
249 nums[nlen - 1] = 0;
250 }
251
252 mp_size_t roffset = i * M;
253 mp_size_t shl = roffset & (LIMB_BITS - 1);
254 roffset /= LIMB_BITS;
255
256 if (shl)
257 lmmp_shl_(nums, nums, nlen, shl);
258
259 if (i == 0) {
260 // 首个系数未移位，超出 [dst,rn] 的扩展 limb 已清零。
261 rhead = LMMP_MIN(nlen, rn);
262 lmmp_copy(dst, nums, rhead);
263 } else if (roffset + nlen <= rn) {
264 lmmp_add_(dst + roffset, nums, nlen, dst + roffset, rhead - roffset);
265 rhead = roffset + nlen;
266 } else {
267 maxc += lmmp_add_(dst + roffset, nums, rn - roffset, dst + roffset, rhead - roffset);
268 maxc += lmmp_add_(dst, dst, rn, nums + rn - roffset, nlen + roffset - rn);
269 rhead = rn;
270 }
271 }
272
273 if (!lmmp_add_1_(dst, dst, rn, 1 + maxc))
274 lmmp_dec(dst);
275
276 lmmp_fft_memstack_(&msr, 0);
277}

139 mp_limb_t u = o - (mp_limb_t)P; \

80 {
81 mp_limb_t d = 0, mb = 0;
82 mp_size_t i = 0;
83
84#define LMMP_SUBSHL1_STEP(k) \
85 { \
86 mp_limb_t v = numb[i + (k)]; \
87 mp_limb_t lo = (v << 1) | mb; \
88 mb = v >> (LIMB_BITS - 1); \
89 mp_limb_t o = numa[i + (k)]; \
90 mp_limb_t u = o - lo; \
91 mp_limb_t r = u - d; \
92 d = (u > o) + (r > u); \
93 dst[i + (k)] = r; \
94 }
95
96 for (; i + 4 <= n; i += 4) {
97 LMMP_SUBSHL1_STEP(0)
98 LMMP_SUBSHL1_STEP(1)
99 LMMP_SUBSHL1_STEP(2)
100 LMMP_SUBSHL1_STEP(3)
101 }
102 for (; i < n; i++) {
103 LMMP_SUBSHL1_STEP(0)
104 }
105#undef LMMP_SUBSHL1_STEP
106 return d + mb;
107}

86 {
87 lmmp_param_assert(dst != NULL && numa != NULL);
88 do {
89 if (na == 0)
90 return 0;
91 } while (numa[--na] == 0);
92 ++na;
93
94 const uint16_t* ptab = upper ? lmmp_hex_pair_upper : lmmp_hex_pair_lower;
95 mp_limb_t top = numa[na - 1];
96 int bits = lmmp_limb_bits_(top);
97 mp_size_t digits = (mp_size_t)((LIMB_BITS * (na - 1) + bits + 3) >> 2);
98
99 char* wp = dst;
100 for (mp_size_t i = 0; i < na - 1; ++i) {
101 mp_limb_t l = numa[i];
102 for (int j = 0; j < 8; ++j) {
103 uint16_t p = ptab[l & 0xff];
104 wp[0] = (char)p; // 低 nibble 字符在前
105 wp[1] = (char)(p >> 8); // 高 nibble 字符
106 wp += 2;
107 l >>= 8;
108 }
109 }
110 while (top >> 4) { // 剩余至少 2 个 nibble
111 uint16_t p = ptab[top & 0xff];
112 wp[0] = (char)p;
113 wp[1] = (char)(p >> 8);
114 wp += 2;
115 top >>= 8;
116 }
117 if (top)
118 *wp++ = (char)ptab[top];
119
120 return digits;
121}

175 } while (numa[--na] == 0);

179 if (LMMP_POW2_Q(base)) {
180 mp_limb_t curlimb = numa[na - 1];
181 int cnt = lmmp_bases_table[base - 2].large_base;
182 int bitsh = lmmp_limb_bits_(curlimb);
183 int mask = (1 << cnt) - 1;
184 mp_size_t bits = bitsh + LIMB_BITS * (na - 1);
185 digits = (bits - 1) / cnt + 1;
186 dst += digits;
187 int bitpos = digits * cnt - LIMB_BITS * (na - 1);
188

191 *--dst = curlimb >> bitpos & mask;
192 }
193 if (--na == 0)
194 break;
195 mp_limb_t prevlimb = curlimb << -bitpos;
196 curlimb = numa[na - 1];
197 bitpos += LIMB_BITS;
198 *--dst = (prevlimb | curlimb >> bitpos) & mask;
199 } while (1);
200 } else if (na < TO_STR_BASEPOW_THRESHOLD) {
201 digits = lmmp_to_str_basecase_(dst, numa, na, base, 0);
202 } else {

204 mp_basepow_t powers[LIMB_BITS];
205 mp_size_t exps[LIMB_BITS];
206 mp_limb_t lbase = lmmp_bases_table[base - 2].large_base;
207 mp_size_t digitspl = lmmp_bases_table[base - 2].digits_in_limb;
208 mp_size_t bexp = (lmmp_to_str_len_(numa, na, base) - 1) / digitspl + 1;
209 mp_size_t tzbit = lmmp_tailing_zeros_(lbase);
210 // numa 的拷贝空间，多一个 limb 预留规整化移位所需
211 mp_size_t alloc_size = na + 1;
212 mp_limb_t cy;
213 mp_ptr tp;
214
215 int cpow = 0;
216
217 do {
218 bexp = (bexp + 1) >> 1;
219 exps[cpow] = bexp;
220 ++cpow;
221
222 // we will calculate lbase^(bexp-1) first, and trim it s. t.
223 // it contains at most 2 tailing 0 limb, then multiply it by lbase,
224 // so we need npow limbs to store lbase^bexp
225 mp_size_t npow = lmmp_from_str_len_(0, (bexp - 1) * digitspl + 1, base) + 1;
226
227 // space needed for quotients in recursive calls,
228 // quotients are smaller than lbase^bexp
229 alloc_size += npow + 1;
230
231 if (tzbit) {
232 mp_size_t tzlimb = tzbit * (bexp - 1) / LIMB_BITS;
233 if (tzlimb >= 2)
234 npow -= tzlimb - 2;
235 }
236
237 // space needed for a trimmed npow-limb lbase^bexp and its inverse
238 alloc_size += npow * 2;
239 } while (bexp > 1);

241 tp = BALLOC_TYPE(alloc_size, mp_limb_t);

244 tp[0] = lbase;
245 powers[i].p = tp;
246 powers[i].np = 1;
247 tp += i + 1;
248 powers[i].zeros = 0;
249 powers[i].digits = digitspl * (i + 1);

254 mp_size_t zeros = 0, np = 1;
255 bexp = 1;
256 for (int i = 2; i < cpow; ++i) {

258 bexp *= 2;
259 np *= 2;
260 np -= tp[np - 1] == 0;
261 if (bexp + 1 < exps[cpow - 1 - i]) {
262 cy = lmmp_mul_1_(tp, tp, np, lbase);
263 tp[np] = cy;
264 np += cy != 0;
265 ++bexp;
266 }
267 zeros *= 2;
268 while (tp[0] == 0) {
269 // at most 2 tailing 0 limb here
270 ++zeros;
271 ++tp;
272 --np;
273 }
274 p = tp;
275 powers[i].p = p;
276 powers[i].np = np;
277 powers[i].zeros = zeros;
278 powers[i].digits = digitspl * (bexp + 1);
279 powers[i].base = base;
280 tp += np + 1;
281 }
282
283 for (int i = 1; i < cpow; ++i) {
284 p = powers[i].p;
285 np = powers[i].np;
286 cy = lmmp_mul_1_(p, p, np, lbase);
287 p[np] = cy;
288 np += cy != 0;
289 if (p[0] == 0) {
290 ++powers[i].zeros;
291 ++p;
292 --np;
293 }
294
295 powers[i].p = p;
296 powers[i].np = np;
297
298 // Note: all powers except powers[0] are normalized
299 // ASSERT: powers[0] will be never used in lmmp_to_str_divide_
300 // i.e. TO_STR_DIVIDE_THRESHOLD >= 3
301 int cnt = lmmp_leading_zeros_(p[np - 1]);
302 if ((powers[i].norm_cnt = cnt))
303 lmmp_shl_(p, p, np, cnt);
304
305 if (np < DIV_MULINV_L_THRESHOLD) {
306 // use divs, no need to compute inv
307 powers[i].invp = 0;
308 powers[i].ni = 0;
309 } else {

312 lmmp_inv_prediv_(tp, p, np, ni);
313 powers[i].invp = tp;
314 powers[i].ni = ni;
315 tp += ni;
316 }
317 }

320 digits = lmmp_to_str_divide_(dst, tp, na, powers + cpow - 1, tp + na + 1, 0);
321
322 TEMP_FREE;
323 }

325 return digits;

42 return lmmp_mulh_(na * LIMB_BITS + mslbits, lmmp_bases_table[base - 2].inv_lg_base) + 1;
43}

引用了 LIMB_BITS, lmmp_bases_table, lmmp_limb_bits_, lmmp_mulh_, lmmp_param_assert , 以及 lmmp_to_str_len_().

判零函数

参数

注解
从最高位开始检查，只要有非零位则返回0。

在文件 cmp.c 第 55 行定义.

55 {
56 lmmp_param_assert(n > 0);
57 lmmp_param_assert(p != NULL);
58 /* 同 lmmp_cmp_ 的剥皮结构 */
59 mp_size_t r = n & 3;

61 for (mp_size_t k = 0; k < r; k++) {
62 if (p[n - 1 - k] != 0)
63 return 0;
64 }
65 /* 余段按 4 limb 一组，或折叠非零检测 */
66 for (mp_size_t i = n - r; i != 0;) {
67 i -= 4;
68 if ((p[i] | p[i + 1] | p[i + 2] | p[i + 3]) != 0)
69 return 0;
70 }
71 return 1;
72}
